trust_decision.summary: Which user-account fields a caller may write through the API: SSO identity fields (sso*Id/sso*Email/ssoGithubUsername) must only be set by the backend SSO helpers, but users/update accepts and picks them from request input for any user editing their own record.

landing_point.why: The summary says mass assignment of SSO fields on the user account; PATCH /api/users/:id is the user self-edit controller and its _.pick list names the SSO fields explicitly.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both changed hunks are in one controller; the sink helper server/api/helpers/users/update-one.js:87-91 spreads values into User.updateOne().set() unfiltered but was not changed by the fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: POST /api/users (users/create) still accepts and picks all SSO identity fields, but it is admin-only (server/config/policies.js:21), so a solver can argue admins are trusted and the advisory is about self-service mass assignment.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: SSO helpers must still be able to write sso*Id/sso*Email through the same users.updateOne/createOne helpers (link-on-first-login, sync on each login), and users/update must still let users edit name/phone/organization/avatar and the internal lastLogin; filtering SSO keys inside the shared helper would break SSO linking.

O6_input_shapes: plain string values for each of the 9 SSO keys (sso{Google,Github,Microsoft,Oidc}Id, sso*Email, ssoGithubUsername)
null values (allowNull: true) for each key, i.e. unlinking

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin user creation accepts and copies all 9 SSO identity fields from request input into the new account, so an account can be pre-bound to an arbitrary IdP subject.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-only route (server/config/policies.js:21); admins are trusted to manage users.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, sibling controller (server/api/controllers/users/create.js:110-126 pick list)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Board import creating missing users could copy SSO fields from the export JSON user records.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer preserving full user identity across instance migration would plausibly copy more user columns from the export; it is a different module (board import) from the users controllers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Shared helper spreads caller values into User.updateOne().set() with no key filter; another self-service controller (e.g. update-username/update-email) passing more of its inputs would reach the same sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Several self-service controllers already funnel into this helper (server/api/controllers/users/update-username.js:82, update-email.js:80).

O9_family: mass assignment / improper authentication (SSO identity binding writable by user, CWE-915/CWE-287)

O10_build.project_tests: Minimal: server/test/integration/models/User.test.js and server/test/lifecycle.test.js; no controller tests for users/update or users/create.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove the SSO keys from users/update input schema and pick list only (exactly the published fix), or strip them only for non-admins, leaving users/create untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: users/update still accepts lastLogin as a free 'ref' input from any user (server/api/controllers/users/update.js:85-87), unrelated to SSO binding.
Email-based SSO account linking (server/api/helpers/users/get-create-one-for-oidc-sso.js:76-105) is a separate, previously fixed advisory (commit 484c92d5).
unverified: Whether users/create still accepts SSO fields in the latest release: no latest code provided.
Sails blueprints are disabled via server/.sailsrc:6, so no auto REST route on User was assumed; not confirmed by running.
Whether the advisory's property is meant to cover admin-set SSO fields at creation is an interpretation; the fix removed admin ability on update too, which supports it.
